# WebZap Jobs

> {{ description }}

## How it works

1. Write freely what you are looking for: your field, interests, last position, where you live, remote or not, salary
   expectations, and what you do *not* want. Any language works.
2. Confirm your email address (double opt-in).
3. Every day the service checks open positions and emails you only the ones that really fit – daily or weekly, as you
   choose. Strict on purpose: no match means no email.

Sources: {{ boards }} employer career pages (through their public applicant-tracking APIs)
{%- if aggregators %}, the job boards {{ aggregators | join(", ") }}{% endif %}
{%- if partners %}, and the partner job search engines {{ partners | join(", ") }}{% endif %}.

## Facts

- Free for job seekers. Sponsored jobs and partner links in the emails are always labelled; neither ever gets the
  subscriber's email address or text.
- Languages: {{ langs | join(", ") }} (every page and email).
- Privacy: no cookies, no trackers, email addresses and texts encrypted at rest; every email has a one-click link to
  change, pause or delete everything.
- Open source (MIT): {{ repo_url }}
